title: Zesty Rich Mexican Poblanos Horchata
description: A rich and creamy Mexican dish featuring roasted poblanos and toffee popcorn, perfect for a brunch mood. This halal-friendly horchata is a unique twist on traditional Mexican cuisine.
instructions: Roast the poblanos in a 400 degree oven for 30 minutes, then peel and chop them.
In a large pot, combine the rice, cinnamon sticks, and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
In a blender, combine the roasted poblanos, toffee popcorn, vanilla extract, and a splash of almond milk, and blend until smooth.
In a large saucepan, combine the blended poblano mixture, brown sugar, and salt, and stir over medium heat until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the remaining almond milk to the saucepan, and stir until the mixture is hot and creamy.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork, and stir it into the horchata mixture.
Serve the Zesty Rich Mexican Poblanos Horchata hot, garnished with additional toffee popcorn if desired.
